```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi = 300
)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  here, ggplot2, dplyr, scales, cowplot, dampack,
  flexsurv, survival
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
)
```

```{r load-analysis-scripts, include=FALSE}
# Source required analysis scripts
suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/02_setup_and_global_variables.R"))
}))

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here("scripts/R/analysis/03_biomarker_strategies.R"))
}))

# Source helper functions
source(here("scripts/R/functions/model_fun.R"))
source(here("scripts/R/functions/calculate_outcomes.R"))
source(here("scripts/R/functions/multi_model_cea.R"))
```

```{r run-basecase-analyses, include=FALSE}
# Run base case analysis for all three model structures
cat("Running base case analyses for all model structures...\n")

all_model_results <- run_all_basecase_analyses(verbose = TRUE)

cat("\nAll base case analyses complete.\n")
```

```{r create-ce-planes, include=FALSE}
# Extract results for each model
result_A <- all_model_results$Model_A
result_B <- all_model_results$Model_B
result_C <- all_model_results$Model_C

# Create CE plane plots using dampack
# dampack::plot returns ggplot objects that can be customized

ce_plot_A <- plot(result_A$icer_obj,
                  txtsize = 8,
                  currency = "EUR",
                  effect_units = "QALYs",
                  label = "all") +
  ggtitle("Model A: Joint") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

ce_plot_B <- plot(result_B$icer_obj,
                  txtsize = 8,
                  currency = "EUR",
                  effect_units = "QALYs",
                  label = "all") +
  ggtitle("Model B: Focused") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

ce_plot_C <- plot(result_C$icer_obj,
                  txtsize = 8,
                  currency = "EUR",
                  effect_units = "QALYs",
                  label = "all") +
  ggtitle("Model C: Separate") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
```

```{r combined-figure, fig.width=10, fig.height=10}
# Combine into 2x2 grid (3 plots + empty space)
combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  ce_plot_A, ce_plot_B,
  ce_plot_C, NULL,
  ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
  labels = c("A", "B", "C", ""),
  label_size = 14
)

print(combined_plot)
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
figs_dir <- here("figs")
if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) {
  dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

ggsave(
  filename = here("figs", "figure2.png"),
  plot = combined_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "figure2.png"), "\n")
```

Figure 2 has been saved to `figs/figure2.png`.
